title: Tests + CLI E2E regression for envelope wallet
description: Unit tests for round-trip (0/1/3 identity wallets), active-identity preservation, v1-byte rejection with spec'd error, unknown-version rejection, tampered-ciphertext AEAD failure. Regenerate any fixtures that bake v1 byte sequences. Run the existing tests/e2e/ identity CRUD subset (recrypt identity new/list/show/delete/use). Confirm RECRYPT_NO_KEYCHAIN=1 and RECRYPT_CONFIG_DIR paths still work. Drop serde_json from recrypt-cli/Cargo.toml if no remaining wallet-side users.
acceptance_criteria: 1) cargo test -p recrypt-cli passes. 2) just test-e2e passes. 3) cargo tree -p recrypt-cli | grep serde_json shows only legitimate (non-wallet) callers, or nothing.

title: Wallet body conversion: replace serde-JSON with Envelope encode/decode
description: New module recrypt-cli/src/wallet/envelope.rs with to_envelope/from_envelope. Subject is {type: recrypt.wallet, format-version: 2} per spec §3.1. active-identity as an envelope assertion. Each identity is a nested envelope per spec §3.2; key fields as raw byte CBOR. Wire Wallet::save/load to the envelope path; bump VERSION to 2. Update version-byte handling in decrypt_wallet: v1 rejected with the spec'd error string; v2 dispatches to envelope decoder; unknown versions rejected. Drop Serialize/Deserialize derives on WalletData/Identity if no longer needed. Convert any base58/base64 key fields to raw bytes.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Round-trip test passes for a fixture with 1 mock identity. 2) grep for base58/base64/bs58 in recrypt-cli/src/wallet/ returns nothing relevant. 3) cargo test -p recrypt-cli wallet -- --test-threads=1 passes.

title: Wire-side plumbing: expose envelope primitives to recrypt-cli
description: Audit what envelope APIs recrypt-cli will need (Envelope, CBOR, Map, try_from_cbor_data, signature helpers if any). If anything required is not already public from recrypt-wire, add a narrow pub use bc_envelope::prelude::* re-export in recrypt-wire/src/lib.rs. Add recrypt-wire as a path dependency in recrypt-cli/Cargo.toml if not already present.
acceptance_criteria: 1) A scratch test in recrypt-cli that constructs an empty Envelope via recrypt_wire::* compiles. 2) just build is clean.

title: Migrate wallet to Gordian Envelope format
description: Replace recrypt-cli's JSON-in-XChaCha20Poly1305 wallet body with a Gordian Envelope (dCBOR) body, sealed by the same Argon2id + XChaCha20-Poly1305 outer shell. Bump the on-disk shell version byte from 1 to 2; reject v1 with a clear error (no migration). All identity key fields move to raw bytes. Spec: docs/standards/wallet-envelope-format.md.
design: Crate ownership: keep WalletData and Identity in recrypt-cli (wallets are local-only, never on the wire). Borrow envelope primitives from recrypt-wire via narrow re-export rather than moving wallet types into recrypt-wire. Defer all spec §8 future assertions (keyspace-membership, delegated-capability, preference, backup-metadata, recovery-share) — they get assertion-name reservations only when their features land.
acceptance_criteria: 1) format.rs VERSION constant is 2. 2) Wallet::load rejects v1 with 'Wallet format v1 is no longer supported. Create a new wallet with recrypt identity new.' 3) Plaintext after AEAD decrypt parses as Envelope with subject {type: recrypt.wallet, format-version: 2}. 4) All identity key fields are raw bytes; no base58/base64 inside the wallet. 5) active-identity is an envelope assertion, not a subject field. 6) Round-trip save→load yields a byte-equal WalletData. 7) RECRYPT_NO_KEYCHAIN=1 and RECRYPT_CONFIG_DIR continue to work. 8) just test-e2e identity CRUD subset passes. 9) No serde_json usage in recrypt-cli/src/wallet/.

title: Flip wallet-envelope-format.md status from Design proposal to Stable
description: Edit docs/standards/wallet-envelope-format.md: change Status from 'Design proposal' to 'Stable'. Confirm §10 implementation sketch reflects the chosen module path (recrypt-cli/src/wallet/envelope.rs). Verify docs/architecture.md wallet description matches new shape; if any user-visible error strings changed, note in docs/user-guide.md.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Status banner reflects reality. 2) Inbound links still resolve.
